idea-plugin.name: Codex Tabs
idea-plugin.description:
Codex, Claude Code, and your own API connections in native IntelliJ IDEA tabs. Keep a chat beside the code it changes, split tasks across editor groups, and return to saved conversations when you need them.

Make room for more than one task

  • Real editor tabs. Split, move, pin, and restore chats with the IDE. Keep independent conversations open beside source files.
  • See what needs you. A chat sidebar and colored tab icons distinguish active work, pending approvals, and unread results. Search, pin, or archive conversations.
  • Keep changes in context. Create and share Git worktrees, review native diffs, open terminals, and include selected code or open files in a prompt.

Choose the connection. Keep the workflow.

  • Codex and Claude Code. Use your existing CLI sign-in, select models, and switch providers in an idle chat while keeping the conversation text and draft.
  • Custom and local models. Add a compatible Responses API connection in settings, or configure a local model by its server URL, model ID, and context size. GLM compatibility settings remain available. API keys are stored in the IDE credential store.
  • Control the next step. Review tool approvals, stop a turn, or steer it. In Claude, Enter queues a follow-up, Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) steers, and Shift+Enter adds a new line.

Read the work, not a wall of tool output

  • Stream Markdown, code, file changes, plans, and images. Group tool activity into expandable rows.
  • Render Mermaid diagrams with source and expanded views. Preview image attachments and copy conversations as Markdown.
  • Inspect context usage and output speed when the provider supplies token counts. Custom API rate limits retry with a visible countdown and a Stop control.
  • Edit an earlier prompt into a new chat while keeping the original. Restore history, drafts, and attachments across IDE restarts.

Get started

  1. Install the plugin and restart IntelliJ IDEA.
  2. Install and sign in to the Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI. For a custom API, install Codex CLI and add the connection in Settings > Tools > Codex Tabs.
  3. Choose Tools > Codex Tabs > New Chat Tab, or press Ctrl+Alt+N with the default keymap.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1 or newer with its bundled JCEF runtime. Supports local projects and Windows projects backed by WSL. Custom endpoints must support the Responses API with tool calling. Chat Completions alone is not enough.

Free and open source under the MIT license. Provider subscriptions or API charges may apply. The plugin runs no separate cloud service. Conversations are sent through the provider you select.

Setup guide · API connections · Report an issue · Changelog

Independent project. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.21

  • Keep chat panels out of source-file analysis and index-backed editor notifications. This avoids the Kubernetes config check that could freeze new chat tabs while WSL indexing was blocked.
  • Use Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter to steer Claude. Shift+Enter now inserts a new line. Enter still queues a follow-up during a running turn.
  • Add custom Responses API connections with secure key storage, connection checks, and automatic rate-limit retries.
  • Show output speed beside chat status, inspect context usage, and track local model token usage.
  • Improve loop recovery with distinct corrective messages and reset the recovery count after progress.
  • Configure additional writable folders, use session approvals, and inspect Claude background tasks and goals.

See the full changelog for earlier releases.
